name: simple-english-hook
description: Enforces ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English on every Codex reply. Hooks, $ste toggle, strict lint gate. Companion to the simple-english plugin.

interface.shortDescription: Simplified Technical English on every reply
interface.longDescription: Loads the ASD-STE100 rules at session start, reminds the model on every prompt, and in strict mode lints each reply and asks for a rewrite.
